entities.description: An extra light probe for Bake Lighting. Moving objects here pick up the baked bounce light, on top of the probes placed on a grid
The brush becomes the box of a ReflectionProbe, which captures its surroundings for reflections inside it

properties.name: intensity
properties.description: Brightness of the reflections

properties.name: update
properties.description: Capture once when the scene starts, or every frame for moving objects (costly)

properties.name: box_projection
properties.description: Lines reflections up with the box walls, good for rooms

properties.name: interior
properties.description: Leaves the sky out, for rooms without windows

properties.name: max_distance
properties.description: Meters the probe sees past its box, 0 for the box only

entities.description: The brush becomes the box of a VoxelGI, real time bounce light that follows moving lights and objects. It is baked in the Godot editor when the map is built

properties.name: subdiv
properties.description: Voxels along the longest side, more is sharper and slower

properties.name: energy
properties.description: Brightness of the bounce light

properties.name: bake_on_build
properties.description: Bakes the volume in the Godot editor each time the map is built
